description: This PHP source file defines the AdminSocialCommitmentEditForm class, which extends AbstractFormProcessor. It manages the creation and processing of a form used for editing social commitment data within an admin interface, including fields for name, description, icon, footprints, and SDGs, and handles saving this data to a model.

classes.name: AdminSocialCommitmentEditForm
classes.description: A form processor class for editing social commitment data in the admin panel, handling form creation, validation, and saving.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for a given form field, specifically enforcing that 'name' is not blank.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs and configures the form with fields for name, description, icon, footprints, and SDGs, populating choices from associated models; returns the form processor instance.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submitted form data, handles icon uploads/removals, updates the data model, performs validation, saves changes, and updates related footprints and SDGs.
